browser_captured_at.definition: Per-page browser capture completion time, taken from the original capture file's filesystem mtime (GMT+8).
browser_captured_at.limitation: The browser session did not log a separate navigation timestamp; mtime is the best available proxy. Navigation start time is NOT_RECORDED.

processed_at.definition: Time window in which the collector parsed the six captures and wrote google_indexed_urls.json/csv.

http_checked_at.definition: Time window in which the read-only GET checks ran; this is inside the same collector run as processing.

repo_packaged_at.definition: When the review-repo copies were re-serialized (gsessionid redaction, LF normalization) and README written. This is not a capture or check time.

reverified_at.definition: Supplemental re-access of pages 5 and 6; separate from the original capture and must not be presented as historical evidence.
